clips.start_words: Ed Forman, one of my closest
clips.end_words: depth of knowledge in the data
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says his friend Ed Forman built a company called Executive Development Systems of Dallas - but he didn't start teaching success principles until after he had made a couple hundred million dollars in construction and oil and gas in West Texas.

He learned by doing: applying a principle one way, then finding the one small distinction that actually created the result.

That is why Kevin Trudeau says his own Success Mastery Course comes from decades of applying it himself, not from repeating a book.

Would you trust advice more from someone who did it, or someone who just read about it?

#kevintrudeau #successmindset #entrepreneur #wealthhabits #businesslessons #manifestation
clips.send: A broke online coach sends it to another coach selling advice they haven't lived: shame - real credibility is scar tissue, not a slide deck.
